name: Prediction Markets
description: Browse Polymarket and Kalshi event markets in one table: prices, spreads, volume, liquidity, and close dates, filtered by venue and category. Open a market for its order book, recent trades, outcome breakdown, price history, and resolution rules, with live book and trade updates from Polymarket. Also `gloomberb predictions [...]` on the command line, and a chart-series capability so a market's price history can be plotted beside anything else.
